recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, multi-layered composition featuring three subjects in a triangular arrangement, overlaid with a large, distressed circular graphic and bold, textured typography. The image uses a limited color palette of red, green, and black with visible halftone and screen-print textures.
coreVisualRelationships: Triangular subject placement creates a balanced but dynamic focus.
The large circular graphic acts as a frame and a unifying layer.
High-contrast duotone effects separate the subjects from the vibrant background.
Textured typography is integrated into the central graphic layer.
coreInvariants: Distressed, rough edges on all graphic elements.
Halftone dot patterns in the mid-tones.
Limited color palette (Red, Green, Black, Cream).

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects: two at the top corners angled inward, one centered lower down, creating a stable pyramid base.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central circular graphic and the large typography contained within it.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-left subject, move to the top-right, then drop to the central subject and the large text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense and filled with texture and overlapping elements.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted Green (Subject skin tones and highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background against low-value, high-contrast subjects.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to 4-5 flat or textured colors

letterConstructionRules: Rough, eroded edges simulating a worn stamp or stencil
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are integrated into the circular graphic, appearing to be stamped over the image.

composition.relationshipToImage: Integrated into a circular graphic frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant display face; no secondary text.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the industrial, urban feel of the original.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a duotone collage of three urban subjects in a triangular formation. Use a vibrant red background with green-tinted high-contrast subjects. Apply a halftone texture to the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay a large, distressed circular graphic in the center. Inside the circle, place bold, textured slab-serif uppercase text with eroded edges.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette limited to red, green, and black?
Does the text have a heavy, distressed stamp-like texture?
Is there a visible halftone pattern in the mid-tones?
Are the subjects arranged in a pyramid/triangular layout?

adjustableVariables: Degree of distressing on the text and graphics
Specific hue of the accent green
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Any recognizable brand logos on clothing
Exact letterforms of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent distressing across all graphic elements.
Ensure the text is legible despite the texture.
Verify the triangular composition of the subjects.
Confirm the halftone effect is visible but not overwhelming.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Duotone Collage + Distressed Slab Serif + Halftone Overlay
